# T-1043: SAVE5 discount code overcharges customers
Reporter: Support (tier 1)
Priority: high

Several customers who used the SAVE5 code ($5 off) were charged more than the price shown in their cart preview. Example: order A-1043, a cart with an $11.00 subtotal, was charged $6.91 but the preview showed $6.50. Percentage codes such as SAVE10 seem fine.

Please fix and ship.

Suspected Code Area: Pricing or discount calculation module handling fixed-amount discounts (like $5 off) versus percentage discounts.
